name: 89120 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89120 (Las Vegas) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89120 (Las Vegas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
